You see a blue crystal shard.
It weighs 0.20 oz.

    Notes

    A creature product with no practical use at present. It can be sold to NPCs and as with other creature products, it has among the highest gold-to-oz ratio of all items. 10 of them can be obtained from Mucus Plugs.
